pieces.Text: You learned early on to modify the patterns around you to grant yourself protection as a swift action. You choose from the options below and may only have one such effect active at any given time. You can use this ability for
rounds per day. You can maintain this ability as long as you want as long as you have rounds available, or dismiss it at any time as a free action.  Absorb: You gain DR
dodge bonus to AC.  Retaliate: You gain a +
bonus on your attack rolls against any opponent that successfully hit you since your last turn.
